description_en: Updates the enablement status of an instance configuration based on the input parameters
description_zh: 根据传入参数更新实例启动状态
kebab_example: aliyun alidns update-cloud-gtm-instance-config-enable-status --accept-language zh-CN --client-token 1ae05db4-10e7-11ef-b126-00163e240000 --instance-id gtm-cn-wwo3a3h0000 --config-id Config-0000000 --enable-status enable --region cn-hangzhou
name: UpdateCloudGtmInstanceConfigEnableStatus

parameters.help_en:
The language of the response. Valid values:

zh-CN: Chinese.

en-US (default): English
parameters.help_zh:
返回值语言，取值： 
          
zh-CN：中文。

en-US（默认值）：英文
parameters.name: accept_language

parameters.help_en: A client-generated token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. The token must be unique among different requests and can contain a maximum of 64 ASCII characters
parameters.help_zh: 用户生成的请求token。用于保证请求的幂等性。注意  由客户端生成该参数值，要保证在不同请求间唯一，最大值不超过64个ASCII字符
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en: The ID of the GTM 3.0 instance that you want to modify
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the domain name instance configuration. For the same access domain name and GTM instance, you can configure both A and AAAA records. This results in two domain name instance configurations for the GTM instance. The ConfigId uniquely identifies a specific configuration.

Call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2797349.html operation to query the ConfigId of a domain name instance
parameters.help_zh:
域名实例配置ID，相同接入域名、相同的GTM实例可以同时配置A和AAAA记录，此情况下相同的GTM实例会出现2个域名实例配置，ConfigId可以唯一标识域名实例配置。

调用[ListCloudGtmInstanceConfigs]( ~~2797349~~)接口可查询域名实例对应的 ConfigId 值
parameters.name: config_id

parameters.help_en:
The enablement status of the domain name instance. Valid values:

enable: Enables the domain name instance.

disable: Disables the domain name instance
parameters.help_zh:
域名实例的启用状态：

enable：启用。

disable：禁用
parameters.name: enable_status

RequestId.description_en: The unique ID of the request

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the operation is successful. Valid values:

true: The operation is successful.

false: The operation failed
Success.description_zh:
本次操作是否成功：
true：调用成功。
false：调用失败
